description: Na₃SnSi₃O₉F crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.85 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.20 Å) and one longer (2.25 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.37 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.12 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.05 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) Sn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-47°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are two shorter (1.61 Å) and two longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. F is bonded to four Na atoms to form edge-sharing FNa₄ tetrahedra.
